label: TP
reason: Both alerts target the sink 'bar' used in response.getWriter().printf (line 65). Data flows from request.getParameterNames() to 'name', then to 'param' (assigned if value matches 'BenchmarkTest00547'), then to 'bar'. An attacker can inject script tags into the parameter name to control 'bar'. No sanitization prevents this. Both alerts are alert-TP.

evidence.note: Shows data flow from request.getParameterNames() to param/bar and usage in printf sink without sanitization.
